title: ShopFusion Sales Dashboard
summary: Authenticated sales and e-commerce dashboard built with Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL and NextAuth.
description: ShopFusion Sales Dashboard is a private full-stack product that combines an authenticated sales dashboard with an evolving e-commerce domain model. It includes roles, product catalog APIs, inventory relationships, cart and order modeling, and deployment-oriented Prisma workflows.

The project is built around a modern App Router stack with Next.js 16, React 19, Prisma 7, PostgreSQL, NextAuth v5, Tailwind CSS and Chart.js, with roadmap-driven delivery across catalog, checkout and admin workflows.
highlights: Implemented authenticated dashboard foundations with role-aware access patterns
Modeled products, variants, inventory, carts, orders and payments with Prisma
Built product API foundations with filtering, pagination and roadmap-backed delivery phases

title: Talk2U Language Learning App
summary: Language learning application for English, Spanish and French with gamified paths and Firebase-backed services.
description: Talk2U Academy is a cross-platform language learning application with authentication, course management, achievement tracking, gamified paths and daily learning flows. The repository includes CI automation and Firebase Hosting deployment workflows.
The product combines React Native and Expo on the client side with Firebase services, Express.js, GraphQL/Apollo patterns and API integration for learning content and user progress.
highlights: Built multi-platform learning flows for web and mobile users
Integrated Firebase services for authentication, hosting and backend data
Structured course, lesson, achievement and notification-oriented product modules

title: WhatsApp Business Webhook API
summary: Python webhook service for WhatsApp Business API chatbot automation.
description: WABA API is a private Python service focused on WhatsApp Business API integration, webhook handling and chatbot response logic. It follows a lightweight Flask-style backend structure with command and response modules.
The project is useful as a backend automation case because it centers on inbound messaging, webhook processing, bot command routing and deployable Python service setup.
highlights: Implemented webhook-oriented WhatsApp Business API integration patterns
Structured chatbot command and response logic for maintainable automation
Prepared Python service setup with virtual environment and dependency workflow

title: ROI Manager
summary: Deployed ROI management interface focused on tracking return, campaign performance and business metrics.
description: ROI Manager is a private deployed web application for organizing and visualizing return-on-investment workflows. The repository is a compact product case for dashboard UX, metric-oriented screens and Vercel deployment.
The current public README is still scaffold-level, so this entry intentionally keeps implementation claims conservative until the source is reviewed locally or cloned into the workspace.
highlights: Shipped a deployed business-metrics interface on Vercel
Built a portfolio-ready analytics product surface
Kept private repository metadata linked for authenticated review

title: ASM Commerce Platform
summary: Private MedusaJS commerce platform split across backend, storefront and architecture/regionalization proof-of-concepts.
description: The ASM commerce work is represented locally by private Quality Digital repositories for a MedusaJS backend, a Next.js storefront and architecture/regionalization proof-of-concepts. The backend uses Medusa v2 with TypeScript, PostgreSQL-oriented commerce modules, Algolia search integration and integration/unit test scripts.

The frontend is based on the Medusa Next.js starter with Next.js 15, React, Tailwind CSS and storefront flows for product discovery, cart, checkout and customer account areas. The local clone history confirms Quality Digital remotes and corporate contributors while Rafael commits appear under personal e-mail aliases.
highlights: Worked across Medusa v2 backend and Next.js storefront architecture
Integrated Algolia-oriented catalog search and commerce backend modules
Validated regionalization and architecture proof-of-concepts in private Quality Digital repositories

title: Cloud Integration Platform
summary: Event-driven integration platform connecting enterprise systems through GraphQL APIs and Kafka streams.
description: At Expertise Solutions I worked across the stack on a platform that integrated several enterprise systems. The backend exposed a GraphQL API powered by NestJS and TypeScript, while data flowed asynchronously between services through Kafka topics.

I implemented resolvers, background consumers and database access with TypeORM and PostgreSQL, and helped ship a React front-end that consumed the API. Everything ran in Docker, which made local development and deployments predictable.
highlights: Built GraphQL resolvers and Kafka consumers for asynchronous workflows
Modeled and queried relational data with TypeORM + PostgreSQL
Containerized services with Docker for consistent environments

title: Corporate Learning Platform
summary: Backend for a corporate e-learning product serving courses, progress tracking and analytics.
description: At Keeps I focused on the backend of a corporate learning platform built with Django and Flask. I designed and maintained data models with SQLAlchemy on top of PostgreSQL, and built endpoints that powered course delivery and student progress tracking.
Quality was a priority: I wrote automated tests with Pytest and kept the services containerized with Docker so the team could iterate safely and quickly.
highlights: Designed PostgreSQL schemas and queries with SQLAlchemy
Built course and progress-tracking endpoints in Django and Flask
Wrote Pytest suites to keep the backend reliable

title: Ad Management Web App
summary: Server-rendered web application to manage advertising campaigns and budgets.
description: My first professional development role was at Publya, where I built a full-stack web application with Flask and server-rendered HTML templates. I worked on both the Python backend and the JavaScript/CSS front-end.
The app let users manage advertising campaigns backed by a PostgreSQL database. This is where I learned how a real product comes together from request handling all the way to the rendered page.
highlights: Built features end to end with Flask and HTML templates
Persisted campaign data in PostgreSQL
Added interactivity with vanilla JavaScript and CSS

title: Financial Support Tooling
summary: Support and automation for financial messaging systems using SQL and shell scripting.
description: My first contact with the industry was a technical support internship at Nexxera, a company in the financial messaging space. I investigated and resolved issues, ran SQL queries to diagnose data problems, and automated repetitive tasks with Bash.
I tracked everything through Jira, which gave me an early appreciation for clear communication and reproducible problem solving.
highlights: Diagnosed production issues with targeted SQL queries
Automated recurring tasks with Bash scripts
Managed and documented tickets in Jira
